name: Pantheon 360
description: Developed by USC, NYCU, Cornell, and Bosch Research (CVPR 2026), Pantheon 360 is a 3D-aware 360° video diffusion framework that utilizes an explicit 3D Cache to synthesize geometrically consistent panoramic videos and digital twins.
keyFeatures: 3D-aware 360° video diffusion from single or sparse panoramic images
Explicit 3D Cache acting as a geometric scaffold for camera trajectory control
Eliminates temporal drift and cross-view inconsistency inherent in narrow-FoV video generators
First video diffusion model supporting seamless 360° video interpolation and long-horizon synthesis
Applications in digital twin creation, camera motion stabilization, and Street View enhancement

benchmarks.name: 360° Digital Twin Consistency & Visual Quality (CVPR 2026)
benchmarks.score: Outperforms perspective video diffusion baselines in geometric stability and temporal fidelity
